newsitem.title: GERMANY: Issing-M3 growth shortfall to be less than 8.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Issing-M3 growth shortfall to be less than 8.4 pct.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing said on Tuesday that the shortfall on the Bundesbank's targets for M3 growth in 1996 would be below October's M3 growth of 8.4 percent.
"We will do slightly better than the October figure of 8.4 percent," Issing said at a conference in Munich.
Earlier, Issing said Germany would not reach its target for money supply growth in 1996 of between four and seven percent.
